title: 厄运小姐·贝壳帽饰
description: 红长发厄运小姐穿完整海盗长外套，在小桌前给帽子别贝壳，双枪安全收在腰侧。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Miss Fortune is an adult pirate captain with very long vivid red hair, green eyes, a broad tricorn-style hat, and a confident playful smile. Preserve her sea-captain silhouette using a fully closed long-sleeved coat over an opaque shirt, covered legs, gloves, and boots. Her paired ornate pistols remain secured in closed side holsters, with no revealing neckline or sexualized pose.
art_direction.scene: She sits beside a quiet dockside table and pins a small shell ornament onto the brim of her hat, which rests flat on the tabletop. A little ribbon spool and a cup stand nearby. Her hair curls softly around the chair, while a moored boat and one gull shape provide a calm seaside backdrop.
art_direction.palette: scarlet hair, navy blue, shell cream, muted brass
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
